caption: The drawing depicts a standing female figure, rendered in shades of brown and gold, on a plain off-white background. She is wearing a long, draped, classical-style garment with detailed folds, and her upper body attire resembles armor with defined breast plates. Her head is covered with a blindfold, and her hair is styled in waves. In her right hand, she holds a straight staff or sword pointed downward. In her left hand, she holds a balance scale with two shallow, circular trays suspended by chains from a horizontal beam. The figure is centrally positioned, taking up most of the vertical space in the image. There are no other objects or elements in the background.
title: Figure of Justice
